title: Blue Cotton Candy Tree
body:
Description

The Blue Cotton Candy Tree spawns on the Finlay Island in the Tundra, where Pine Trees grow.

There is an alternative variant of the Pink Cotton Candy Tree worth more that spawns in the Flowering Meadows.

Textures

The various textures of the Red Maple tree in its raw, sanded, and planked states.

Trivia

  • Cotton Candy trees are very light and are smaller at the base.
  • Although hard to see, the logs have a cardboard texture to mimic a cotton candy stick.
